channel.title: D3DDD Blog
channel.description: Architecture and drafting insights from D3DDD.

item.title: AutoCAD Drafting Standards for Gulf Fit-Out Packages
item.description: Practical AutoCAD drafting standards for UAE and Gulf fit-out work — layers, naming, xrefs, plot styles and revision habits that keep marble, joinery and MEP consultants aligned.

item.title: Marble Shop Drawings in the UAE: A Practical Checklist for Fabricators
item.description: A field-tested checklist for marble and stone shop drawings in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah — piece IDs, edge profiles, joint layouts and what to freeze before the slab is cut.

item.title: Slab Nesting and Cutting Lists: How Gulf Stone Yards Cut Waste
item.description: How slab nesting and cutting lists reduce marble and granite waste for UAE fabricators — piece IDs, yield, vein direction and BOQ habits that survive real yard constraints.

item.title: Jeddah Tower 2026: Halfway to One Kilometre — What Drafters Should Watch
item.description: Jeddah Tower has climbed past 470 m and Level 118. A practical look at the AS+GG design, concrete structure, and what megatall projects mean for shop drawings and 3D coordination.

item.title: NEOM’s The Line, Paused Until 2030: What Drafters Can Still Learn
item.description: The Line’s 170 km vision is on hold until at least 2030. Separating the viral render from the real briefing: scale-backs, Oxagon priority, and drafting lessons that still matter.

item.title: Sagrada Família Hits 172.5 m: Why ‘Finished Height’ Is Not a Finished Building
item.description: In 2026 the Tower of Jesus Christ reached 172.5 m — the basilica’s final height — while construction remains about 70% complete. Lessons on long programmes, stone detailing and honest project communication.
